title: Kar gaye duniya sey qazaa haaye haaye
body:
Kar gaye duniya sey qazaa haaye haaye
Beykas-o-mazloom Raza haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad-e-pidar chaen na ek din milaa
Moreed-e-andoh balaa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah ko mamoon ney angoor mein
Zehr-e-halaahal hai diyaa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Misl-e-Hassan hogaya tukkday jigar
Khaathey hi woh zehr-e-daghaa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Juz alam-o-ranj na tha Sheh kay paas
Koyi dum-e-nazaa na tha haaye haaye
